trial_type.Description: camera_change: a camera-change trigger of the action movie (camInfo row)

Levels.camera_change: camera change in the movie (BORIS 'Trigger' annotation)

sample.Description: camInfo column 4 minus 1 (0-based sample of the trigger in the ECoG file; interpretation inferred from the value range 1..nSamples)

movie_id.Description: camInfo column 2: movie identifier (M01..M22, S01..S22; csv/avi in stimuli/)

movie_type_flag.Description: camInfo column 1: 1 for S-movies, 0 for M-movies in every row (checked in code/conversion_report.json); meaning of S/M per the article (predictable vs unpredictable sequences)

interval_before.Description: camInfo column 5 (s); matches the interval from the previous camera change (inferred)

interval_after.Description: camInfo column 6 (s); matches the interval to the next camera change (inferred)

movie_duration.Description: camInfo column 7: total length of the movie (equals 'Total length' in the BORIS csv; checked in code/conversion_report.json)
